app.name: IT Starter 2028
app.tagline: IT is interesting. You can learn this!

login.title: Welcome!
login.subtitle: Log in to start your IT journey.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your teacher for help.

changePassword.title: Choose your own password
changePassword.forced: Your teacher gave you a temporary password. Please choose a new one that only you know.
changePassword.tip: Tip: a few words together are easy to remember, e.g. "blue-mango-river".

problems.SAME_AS_USERNAME: Don’t use your username as your password.
problems.SAME_AS_CURRENT: Choose something different from your old password.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Start learning IT in a few seconds — free.
register.name: Your name
register.nameHint: Your real name, so your teacher knows who you are.
register.usernameHint: You log in with it. Lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (3–50), e.g. sokha.chan
register.usernameInvalid: Use 3–50 lowercase letters or numbers (you may also use . _ -), starting with a letter or number.
register.usernameReserved: That username is reserved. Please choose another one.
register.closed: New accounts are made by your teacher. Please ask them for your username and password.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That username or password is not right. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD: Your current password is not right.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: Your account is paused. Please ask your teacher for help.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Please wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We could not reach the server. Check your Internet and try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this page.
errors.LESSON_INCOMPLETE: Finish all the activities first, then try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is already taken. Try another one.
errors.REGISTRATION_CLOSED: New accounts are made by your teacher. Please ask them.

learned: Now you know for next time.

dashboard.subtitle: Your IT journey
dashboard.streak: {count, plural, =0 {Start a streak today} one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}

staff.title: Hello, {name}!
staff.body: Open the admin area to manage students, lessons and badges. Below you can preview every world as a student sees it.

lesson.matchingHelp: Tap an item on the left, then tap its match on the right.
lesson.orderingHelp: Use the arrows to put them in order, from first to last.

complete.title: Lesson complete!
complete.noNewXp: You already finished this lesson. Great practice!
complete.streak: {count, plural, one {# day streak} other {# day streak}} 🔥

lesson.keysHelp: Tap the keys. Tap a key again to let go of it.
lesson.categorizeHelp: Drag each item into a group — or tap an item, then tap a group.
lesson.cellHelp: Tap a cell in the sheet.

parts.role: ROLE · who should the AI be?

mouse.double: Double-tap (double-click) the folder to open it.
mouse.long: Press and hold the file — that is a right-click on a phone.
mouse.drag: Drag the file into the folder.
mouse.scroll: Scroll down inside the box to find the treasure.
mouse.menu: A menu appeared: Copy · Rename · Delete
mouse.moved: The file is in the folder!
mouse.skip: I can’t use touch or a mouse — skip this practice

lesson.keyboardTip: Tip: press {keys} to choose an answer and Enter to continue.

games.playAbove: Play the game above — it checks itself when you finish.
games.catchHelp: Tap the right ones as they fall to catch them in your basket!
games.catchCalmHelp: Tap every item that fits, then press Done.
games.basketCount: {count, plural, =0 {Your basket is empty} other {# in your basket}}
games.memoryHelp: Turn over two cards to find a pair.
games.robotMissing: This robot game is not ready yet.
games.robotBoard: Robot board, {rows} rows by {cols} columns. The robot is in row {row}, column {col}.

robotOutcome.wall: Bump! A wall is in the way at move {step}. Fix your program and run it again.
robotOutcome.edge: Oops! The robot would leave the board at move {step}.
robotOutcome.short: The robot stopped before the goal. Add more moves.
robotOutcome.missing: Almost! Pick up everything on the way first.
robotOutcome.too_long: Too many blocks: use at most {max}. Try a repeat block 🔁.

games.programEmpty: Tap the arrows to give the robot instructions.
games.spellHelp: Tap the letters in the right order.
games.sentenceHelp: Tap the words to build the sentence.

common.confirmDelete: Are you sure? Press again to confirm.

overview.unplaced: {count, plural, one {# new student has no class yet. Put them in a class} other {# new students have no class yet. Put them in a class}}

students.title: Students
students.tempPasswordHelp: Give this to the student. It is shown only once; they choose their own password at first login.

import.title: Import students
import.help: One student per line: username, display name, class (optional). A header row is allowed. Example:
import.import: Import {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}
import.fixFirst: Fix the problems in your file, then check again. Nobody was created.
import.ready: Everything looks good. Ready to import.
import.done: {count, plural, one {# student was} other {# students were}} created.
import.passwordsOnce: Save or print these temporary passwords now — they are shown only once.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: How your students are doing. Only totals and averages, never names.
analytics.activeHint: learned something in the last {days} days
analytics.progressHint: Share of all lessons each student has finished.
analytics.engagementHint: Students who learned something each day.
analytics.minutesPerDay: Minutes per student per active day
analytics.onStreak: Students on a streak of 3+ days
analytics.hardestHint: Lowest average score, among lessons at least 3 students finished.
analytics.activitiesHint: Fewest right first answers. Only activities at least {count} students answered.
analytics.noData: No data yet for this period.

progress.title: Learning progress
progress.intro: See how far every student has come — overall, in each world, and how recently they learned.
progress.daysAgo: {days, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again. Your answers are saved on the server, so nothing is lost.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Add IT Starter to your home screen. It opens full screen, like a real app.
install.iosSteps: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share {share}, then “Add to Home Screen” {add}.
install.installed: The app is installed on this device.

performance.title: My progress
performance.intro: How you are learning — keep going, every day counts!

levelHelp.not_started: Start a lesson today — just 10 minutes is a great beginning!
levelHelp.starting: Good start! Try to learn on 3 days every week.
levelHelp.steady: You learn regularly. A little more each week makes it a strong habit!
levelHelp.strong: Amazing! You learn often and keep going. 🌟

staffLevelHelp.not_started: No learning in the last 4 weeks.
staffLevelHelp.starting: Some learning, but not regular yet.
staffLevelHelp.strong: Learns often, spends good time and finishes lessons.

performance.formula: Commitment = days learned (40%) + minutes (30%) + lessons (30%) over the last 4 weeks; targets: 12 days, 120 minutes, 8 lessons.
performance.calendarSummary: Learned on {days} of the last 28 days.
performance.nothingYet: Answer some questions and your strengths will appear here.
